translations.web: “Ask a sign of Yahweh your God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.”
translations.bsb: “Ask for a sign from the LORD your God, whether from the depths of Sheol or the heights of heaven.”
translations.kjv: Ask thee a sign of the LORD thy God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.
translations.asv: Ask thee a sign of Jehovah thy God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.
